metadata.purpose: Start a fixed-duration silence window on the first value and emit its latest value when the scheduled duration ends.

conditions: Emitted values are an ordered subsequence of source values; at most one per duration.
Values arriving during an active duration replace the pending latest value and do not restart it.
Source completion waits for the active timer; unlike debounceTime it does not flush early.
Source error and downstream cancellation discard pending values and release resources.

scope.parameters: Positive safe-integer duration and deferred scheduler, one scheduled task per active window
scope.callbacks: No user callback. Timer output is modeled as timer.fire.
scope.time: Externally supplied monotone safe-integer clock; duration signals or scheduler firings determine output time. No deadline alone emits a value.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant source, callback, observer and duration notifications after initialization. Equal timestamps are ordered by trace sequence.
exclusions: Inline/synchronous custom schedulers, negative/NaN/unsafe durations, non-deferred zero delay, scheduler drift guarantees.
Nested source/duration emissions, cancellation inside callbacks/output delivery and throwing observers/finalizers.
Universal behavioral equivalence, callback purity, and arbitrary external mutation of retained object references.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Connect to source only; first value starts a duration.

ownership.sharing: No sharing or replay introduced. Each result subscription owns its latest value and duration identity.
ownership.reset: Fresh counter and no pending value per execution; Closed rejects later signals.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Schedule once when idle; subsequent values replace memory without rescheduling. timer.fire models a due scheduled emission.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between resolved notifications; no pending-value flush on cancellation.
Source completion may leave a duration active; it does not force emission or cancel that duration.
